description: Investigating the interaction between statistical indices for performance assessment of Hyrum Reservoir on Little Bear River in an optimization model is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Irene Garousi-Nejad (deposited on HydroShare). Population growth and socioeconomic changes in developing countries over the past few decades have created sever stress on the available water resources across the world, particularly in semiarid regions, such as Utah. Hence, the optimal management of water resources is imperative. Coverage: Utah, United States. The resource was created 2017-03-09 and last updated 2017-05-02; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
